Fwd from @ 📝 Hello, we're looking for reserves 📝 Following warnings for weapons manufacturers, the topic of preparing personnel has emerged. According to reports from The Telegraph, the UK Ministry of Defence is laying the groundwork for a possible call-up of veterans from the strategic reserve. One of the publication's sources explained that no one is talking about sudden mobilization, but it " would be madness " not to have a database and access to these people. According to him, much in the system has " gotten quite rusty ". Therefore, the first stage is to find out who these people are, where they are located, and what skills they possess. 📌 The context in the publication is stated directly. Earlier, the publication reported that Lord Sanders, while serving as Chief of the General Staff, told the government about the need to " mobilize the nation " for war with Russia, since the British Army is too small. Now a special section has been opened on the government website. There you can learn what the Strategic Reserve means for the reservists themselves, their families, and employers. Veterans Minister Kelvin Bailey assured that the letters do not mean imminent mobilization. According to him, this is " simply good housekeeping ": you need to know how to contact suitable people and keep their skills information up to date. ❗️ Formally, everything looks like administrative work with databases. But together with warnings about sabotage, talk of " mobilizing the nation " and a new website section for families and employers, a consistent picture emerges. Society is gradually being conditioned to the idea that preparation for a major war is becoming part of everyday life. #UnitedKingdom 👁 @evropar — on the brink of Europe's death 💸 Support us Original msg

⚡️ Statement by the Russian Ice Hockey Federation (November 25, 2026) : The Russian Ice Hockey Federation (RIHF) acknowledges the statement by the International Ice Hockey Federation (IIHF) regarding its intention to appeal the decision of the Court of Arbitration for Sport (CAS) to the Swiss Federal Tribunal. The actions of the IIHF once again demonstrate a lack of intent to respect and comply with the ruling of an international arbitration body , as well as the agreement concluded with the RIHF. The RIHF notes that filing an appeal does not take away the IIHF’s obligation to comply with the decision. It is evident that the IIHF is failing to fulfill this obligation, which, in our view, violates not only the ruling itself, but also the law. The RIHF considers the arguments presented in the IIHF’s press release for challenging the CAS decision to be unfounded and contrived. Furthermore, the RIHF maintains that the IIHF’s actions are violating the agreement with the RIHF with regard to the immediate implementation of the decision. The CAS ruling in favour of the RIHF was reached unanimously, with the concurrence of the arbitrator appointed by the IIHF. Earlier this May, a three-member panel of the IIHF Disciplinary Board had likewise determined that the banning of Russian teams from international competitions was both unfounded and unlawful. Throughout the entire arbitration process, the IIHF raised no objections concerning the independence or impartiality of the arbitrators. It only submitted a request to CAS to disqualify two of the arbitrators two weeks after the unfavourable ruling was issued - a move which violates fundamental procedural rules and is based upon the same contrived arguments. Moreover, the information that the IIHF cites to substantiate its baseless accusations was already publicly available well before the arbitrators were even appointed to hear this case. CAS rightly and lawfully refused to consider this untenable argument provided by the IIHF. ❗️ In light of the above, the RIHF considers the arguments presented by the IIHF in its press release - put forward in order to justify its intention to appeal the CAS decision - to be legally baseless. The entire sporting community can see that the IIHF is resorting to any means necessary, including the abuse of legal rights, in an attempt to cast doubt on the legitimacy of a final and binding arbitral decision, which was unanimously rendered in favour of the RIHF. These actions represent an attempt to evade compliance with the arbitral decision and to discredit the institution of independent sporting justice. The RIHF will continue to consistently and resolutely uphold the principles of Olympism and non-discrimination in sport , and will defend the rights and legitimate interests of Russian athletes while using all available legal routes.

Ветераны трех народов сели за круглый стол на Поклонной горе В Музее Победы на Поклонной горе состоялась встреча представителей ветеранских организаций и органов государственной власти России, Абхазии и Южной Осетии. Участники собрались, чтобы обменяться мнениями и обсудить вопросы, связанные с сохранением исторической памяти и дальнейшим взаимодействием. Единство народов символизирует то советское наследие, которым мы все гордимся. Хотим чтобы оно стало не просто символом, а нашим знаменем. Той звездой, за которой мы все будем идти, объединяя народы, – говорит командир « Пятнашки » Ахра Авидзба. В рамках мероприятия прошёл международный круглый стол «Наследие. Развитие. Единство». В обсуждении приняли участие ветераны и участники военных конфликтов. Одной из центральных тем стала работа с молодёжью: участники рассмотрели планы и направления, которые помогут передавать молодому поколению исторический опыт и поддерживать интерес к общему наследию. Все заинтересованы! Будем взаимодействовать, вместе работать. Если будет нужна наша помощь, а у нас много наработок, мы поделимся. Так же если от братских народов можно будет что-то принять, обязательно сделаем! – пообещал ветеран из Осетии Олег Магкеев. Встреча стала площадкой для диалога между представителями ветеранских сообществ и государственных структур трёх республик. @wargonzo
